systemd is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Security and OSINT](@/projects/security.md) (1).

Most recently: [microcrawler](@/work/microcrawler.md); [zlown](@/work/zlown.md): Rogue and Evil Access Point.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses systemd: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links systemd to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
